Name: Olden Days Interface
Author: HazelNuttAndFrog
Description:
[center][color=#d8d8d8][i]Are you a lazy hobbit? A not-so-great-at-witching witch? Do you wish you could be transported to the world of Anne of Green Gables, The Secret Garden, or anything with a pastoral, olden charm? If so, hello there, kindred spirit. I made this for myself, but maybe it's for you, too *wink, wink* (Sorry about that [/i]😅[i])[/i][/color][/center]
[center][/center]

[color=#f4f4f4]Hi, hello 🙈[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]My name is Toi and I like old books, yellow and green, bees and frogs, sticks and stones. I'm a children's illustrator, and this is sort of my attempt at storybook-ing Stardew Valley. This is a very personal recolour, full of little details that are close to me (you know, them bees and frogs) and the way I play. But my friends kept telling me to share it, so here it is 💛[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]I wanted to keep the interface as close to vanilla-looking as possible (I love this silly game just the way it is, after all!), while giving its colours more depth and richness without losing their saturation. Most changes are based on the original assets, some subtly tweaked, others completely redrawn, to give everything a warmer, livelier, slightly magical feel.[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]I do hope I managed to give it the warmth of a bedtime story someone read to you as a child. Or maybe, you know, that certain nostalgia for a time that only ever really existed in your imagination.[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]This is my first mod, so I hope I didn't forget anything![/color]

[line]


[color=#efefef][size=5][font=Arial][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53659/53659-1792613822-1238330762.png[/img][/b][/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]A warmer, richer colour palette with a more vintage feel overall. I'm rather picky about blues, and many of Stardew Valley's greens leaned a little [i]too[/i] blue for my taste 😅. So I shifted them towards yellow and swapped out some of the bluer elements for other colours, too (looking at you, Joja & Solarion).[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][b]Interface & menus[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Redesigned Title Screen [/color][color=#b6b6b6](with some cute new menu buttons)[/color][color=#f4f4f4] and Help Wanted board.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Redrawn and recoloured menu tabs [/color][color=#b6b6b6](with configurable styles)[/color][color=#f4f4f4], Buffs, Skills and Map Type icons.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Custom Profession and Bundle icons, with the option to turn them off.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]A completely redesigned Joja Form, so it feels a little less soulless. You can even have it stamped now![/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]New letter backgrounds [/color][color=#b6b6b6](I'd love to make custom backgrounds for the Secret Notes and all, too, but my coding knowledge is pretty limited, and I couldn't figure out how to do it from the wiki alone 😭. If anyone knows of a tutorial or something that could help, I'd be forever grateful!)[/color][color=#f4f4f4].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Lighter backgrounds for various UI elements [/color][color=#b6b6b6](including controller maps, fishing mini game, and the Mastery Cave menu)[/color][color=#f4f4f4].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]An updated sewing machine in the Tailoring interface, now matching Emily's [/color][color=#b6b6b6](I need consistency in my life 😅)[/color][color=#f4f4f4].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Matching buttons for Robin's construction menu [/color][color=#b6b6b6](consistency 🙏)[/color][color=#f4f4f4].[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][b]A few other touches[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]A new sky for the clock, with redrawn seasonal icons.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Recoloured skies to match the overall palette.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]A recoloured Crane Game, because its backdrop was looking a little sad.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]A redrawn Solarion Chronicles, now with a bit more detail and character.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]A new back for the Casino Card [/color][color=#b6b6b6](very important)[/color][color=#f4f4f4].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Gave the Weather Report man [b][i]a neck[/i][/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]And a few other little things here and there![/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Config Options:[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Intro: Choose between [b]Gem[/b], [b]Crow[/b], or [b]Dove[/b] for the little title-screen bird.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Tabs: Choose between a [b]Backpack[/b] or [b]Basket[/b] for the menu tabs. You can also choose between [b]Classic[/b], [b]Farmer[/b], or [b]Witchy[/b] icons for the clothing tabs.[/color][/*]
[*]Professions: Set to [b]True[/b] to enable custom profession icons. 
[spoiler][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53659/53659-1791909100-1188577282.png[/img]

[i]Tried to match them as best as I could to their descriptions. Gold is for Level 5 and Iridium for Level 10 [/i]:)[/center]
[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Bundles: Set to [b]True [/b]to enable custom bundle icons. [/color]

[spoiler][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53659/53659-1792605571-647675478.png[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][color=#cccccc][b]A little note about the custom icons 🙈[/b][/color]

[color=#cccccc][i]Both the profession and bundle icons were made with my own (very unfinished) world recolor in mind, so they won't quite match vanilla or other recolours. I wasn't sure whether to include them at first, but they only appear briefly, and they're quite cute, so I decided to go for it anyway. I've included options to turn them off if the mismatch bothers you too much (it's me, I'm that person [/i]😅[i]).[/i][/color]

[i][color=#cccccc]I'm terribly slow and have other things I'm working on right now, so I won't be able to make additional versions myself. But if anyone feels like making a patch or something so they can better match vanilla or other world recolours, please feel free to do so![/color]
[/i]

[size=4][b]Languages:[/b][/size]

[color=#f4f4f4]All vanilla languages are supported, along with Spanish and Japanese translations for the config menu via i18n (I think! I'm not entirely sure I got the i18n thing right, please let me know if you spot any mistakes!).[/color]


[color=#ffe599]🐝 Cambié el título de "Necesito ayuda" por "Se busca ayuda" porque me sonaba un poco más... natural. También modifiqué el calendario y cambié la 'X' por 'Mi'. Entiendo que es una convención, pero jamás en la vida me crucé con una agenda o calendario en que apareciera así y no me puedo acostumbrar 😅. Si prefieren el original, díganme y veo de agregar una opción sin estos cambios 🙏.[/color]


[color=#93c47d]🐸 日本語はまだ勉強中なので、何かおかしかったら教えてください 🙏。[/color]
